questions.q: In a 4,000 m race on a 1,000 m circular track, the fastest runner (twice the slowest's speed) first meets the slowest at the same point after 5 minutes. How long does the fastest take to finish?
questions.why: He gains one lap (1,000 m) in 5 min: v − v/2 = 200, so v = 400 m/min; 4,000 ÷ 400 = 10 min. GPSC CBRT, Jan 2024.

questions.q: At a birthday party, people were asked to guess the number of balloons used for stage decoration. No guess was correct, but the nearest guesses were 171, 177, 186 and 190. The correct number was one, three, ten and sixteen units away from the guesses. How many balloons were used?
questions.why: 187 is 1 from 186, 3 from 190, 10 from 177 and 16 from 171. GPSC CBRT, Nov 2023.

questions.q: In how many ways can the letters of PENCIL be arranged so that the vowels are always together?
questions.why: Treat E, I as one block: 5! × 2! = 240. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: 3 senior and 5 junior technicians finish a project in 8 days for a total wage of ₹2,400. 2 seniors and 10 juniors finish it in 6 days. What will a team of 4 seniors and 5 juniors earn per day on an identical project?
questions.why: 24S + 40J = 12S + 60J, so 3S = 5J. First team is worth 10J and earns 2400 ÷ 8 = 300/day, so J = 30, S = 50. 4 × 50 + 5 × 30 = 350. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W stand in a line facing north. R and W are immediate neighbours of S. V is an immediate neighbour of U and W. T and Q are immediate neighbours of P. Neither T nor R is at an end. U is to the right of T. Who is second to the left of W?
questions.why: Line: Q P T R S W V U. Second left of W is R. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.

questions.q: Four boxes each hold the same number of sweets and carry these labels: 'Five or Six', 'Seven or Eight', 'Six or Seven', 'Seven or Five'. Only one label is correct. How many sweets are in each box?
questions.why: Five, six and seven each make two labels true. Eight makes only 'Seven or Eight' true. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: If 18 December 2026 was a Friday, what day of the week was 18 July 2027?
questions.why: 212 days later; 212 mod 7 = 2, so count 2 days on from Friday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Two ships on opposite sides of a 100 m lighthouse see its top at elevations of 30° and 45°. How far apart are the ships?
questions.why: Distances are 100√3 ≈ 173 m and 100 m; on opposite sides they add to about 273 m. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.

questions.q: A shoe showroom earns 25% profit after a 25% discount. What would the profit be with only a 10% discount?
questions.why: Marked 100 → sells 75 = 1.25 × cost → cost 60. At 90: profit 30 on 60 = 50%. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: What day of the week was 15 August 1947?
questions.why: Independence Day 1947 fell on a Friday. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
